journal_lines: Spider on the ceiling. Didn't give it a chance.
Web across the path. Spider behind it.
Two of them. Handled in order.
Jockey. Spider with a skeleton. Busier.
The web slowed me. Then didn't.
Cave spider. Smaller. The venom is the problem.
Came down from above. Saw the shadow.
The pair of them worked together. Interesting. Then dealt with.
Got one off the ceiling. The other noticed.
Bright eyes in the crack. Pre-empted the ambush.
Silk on the doorframe was the tell.
This breed runs. Cornered it first.
Two of them, one web. Neither survived it.
Spiderlings in the nest behind the adult. Dealt with the nest entirely.
